scalars.scalar_value: Doctoral degree in Health Services, Public Health, Community Health, Health Education, Social/Behavioral Science, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Medicine, Dentistry, Nursing, Pharmacy or directly related scientific field related to health research AND Minimum four (4) years of experience in a scientific field related to health or health services research and/or evaluation or a directly related field.
Ten (10) years of experience performing analytical techniques on a research project(s).
Minimum four (4) years of experience serving as a principal investigator designing and conducting research in an externally and/or internally funded research environment.

items.item_text: Doctoral degree in Health Services, Public Health, Community Health, Health Education, Social/Behavioral Science, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Medicine, Dentistry, Nursing, Pharmacy or directly related scientific field related to health research AND Minimum four (4) years of experience in a scientific field related to health or health services research and/or evaluation or a directly related field.
Minimum four (4) years of experience serving as a principal investigator designing and conducting research in an externally and/or internally funded research environment.
Ten (10) years of experience performing analytical techniques on a research project(s).
Minimum two (2) years of experience managing operational or project budgets.
Minimum five (5) years of experience in a leadership role with or without direct reports.

Creates and advocates for developmental opportunities for others; builds collaborative, cross-functional relationships. Solicits and acts on performance feedback; works with leaders and employees to set goals and provide open feedback and coaching to drive performance improvement. Pursues professional growth; hires, trains, and develops talent for growth opportunities; strategically evaluates talent for succession planning; sets performance management guidelines and expectations across teams / units. Oversees implementation, adapts, and stays up to date with organizational change, challenges, feedback, best practices, processes, and industry trends; shares best practices within and across teams. Fosters open dialogue amongst team members, engages, motivates, and promotes collaboration within and across teams; motivates teams to meet business objectives. Delegates tasks and decisions as appropriate; provides appropriate support, guidance and scope; encourages development and consideration of options in decision making; fosters access to stakeholders.

Manages designated units or teams by translating business plans into tactical action items; oversees the completion of work assignments and identifies opportunities for improvement; ensures all policies and procedures are followed; partners with key stakeholders and business leaders to ensure products and/or services meet requirements and expectations while aligning with departmental strategies. Aligns team efforts; builds accountability for and measuring progress in achieving results; assumes responsibility for decision making; fosters direct reports to resolve escalated issues as appropriate. Communicates goals and objectives; incorporates resources, costs, and forecasts into team and unit plans; ensures matrixed resources are fulfilling service or performance requirements across reporting lines. Removes obstacles that impact performance; identifies and addresses improvement opportunities; guides performance and develops contingency plans accordingly; influences teams and units to operate in alignment with operational and business objectives.

Participates in mentoring activities by: serving as a mentor and advisor to senior team members by providing guidance on research methodologies, project management, and career development, as well as fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment and overseeing mentorship activities across the department/division.

Assists in the management of research projects by: partnering with senior leadership to ensure compliance for all research studies and to drive the appropriate application of all applicable local, state, and federal laws, regulations, and accreditation standards, and any funding agency, grant, and/or contract management policies, and terms and conditions of the award across teams and remaining up to date with all organizational, funding, and regulatory agency policies and procedures, and other regulatory requirements relevant to the research environment by attending trainings; leveraging expert knowledge from within ones field to lead teams in the design and development of highly complex study methodologies, protocols, and data collection and analysis plans, as well as providing strategic and managerial oversight to other scientists within ones division to ensure data quality and scientific integrity across research studies; working with senior leaders to establish expectations on maintaining the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across teams, and leading and/or conducting highly complex qualitative and/or quantitative data collection, cleaning, management, and/or analyses; coaching management and across teams on and collaborating with cross-functional research partners to ensure alignment of project plans, coordinate activities, and provide consultation toward achieving project goals; leading and/or assisting in the development and monitoring of highly complex and/or large research study budgets, timelines, and/or deliverables as well as collaborating with senior management to identify and recommend uses for division/department operation budgets; and collaborating with senior management to determine staffing needs and hiring, training, evaluating performance, and assigning work to team members to ensure integrity, efficiency, and quality of research studies, as well as leading the implementation of training to support staff development.

Contributes to the development of proposals by: leading and supporting the development and writing of large and/or complex proposals with national impact as a principal or co-investigator, from conceptualization to submission and providing oversight to and setting performance expectations for team members as well as contributing to the development of resources and systems within a division to support proposal development; and serving as a resource within a division on the oversight of pre-award activities (e.g., define and negotiation of aspects of the proposal including the scope of work, budget, and identification of research staff) for highly complex and/or large proposals that may vary in number.

Advances knowledge of the scientific community by: leveraging expert knowledge to provide guidance across teams, assist, and/or lead the interpretation and/or presentation of highly complex data; and lead- and/or co-authoring technical products and peer-reviewed publications and/or developing abstracts, posters, and/or presentations to disseminate research findings locally, nationally, or internationally to clinical partners, collaborators, stakeholders, or wider audiences, as well as managing dissemination activities for senior authored products.

Participates in service to the local and scientific community by: serving as a reviewer for scientific journals and grant review panels, participating in committees, conferences, and/or professional organizations, and serving as a resource to the team on insights, advancements, and/or changes in the industry.

Served as an author (lead author, co-author, contributor) on published research products (e.g., journal articles, books, public entity reports, policy briefs, evidence-based reviews, white papers, clinical guidelines).
